title: Support scenario simulator + task template library
creator: Avery Chen
description: Build a lightweight, reusable simulator that lets support engineers and on-call run deterministic scenarios against our admin tooling and runbook tasks. The simulator will: 1) execute task templates (steps + expected outputs) in a sandboxed staging environment, 2) allow injection of failure modes (API timeouts, partial KV cache hits, heavy batching), and 3) produce a structured transcript that maps to our runbooks-as-tasks schema for replay and postmortem analysis. This lowers cognitive load for runbook testing, enables CI checks for new automation, and shortens on-call ramp-up time.
acceptance_criteria: CLI and simple web UI to load a task template and run a scenario in staging
Simulator can inject at least three failure modes: API latency >500ms, KV cache miss storm, and degraded GPU availability
Runs produce a JSON transcript compatible with runbook ingestion service (step id, input, output, status, duration)
Tests added to CI that validate two canonical support scenarios and block PRs when regressions detected
implementation_notes: Prototype leverages existing admin-sandbox infra (helm chart: admin-sandbox) to avoid new provisioning
Use Docker-in-Docker ephemeral workers with strict network namespace to prevent cross-tenant leakage
Prefer in-process failure injections where possible for speed; fallback to proxy-based fault injection for end-to-end fidelity
Telemetry: emit structured spans/tags that Console can surface per scenario run (duration, error-class, step)
Limit scope first iteration to text-generation API paths and the operator CLI commands used by support
implementation_plan: Week 1: design task template schema and minimal UI mockups; get PM/Design alignment
Week 2: implement executor service + docker worker harness and two basic failure injectors
Week 3: CI integration and two canonical scenario templates; runbook ingestion mapping
Week 4: expose simple web UI and hand off to support for alpha testing; collect feedback
testing_plan: Unit tests for executor step runner and sandbox lifecycle
Integration tests in CI using staging cluster with deterministic seed for KV/cache behavior
Chaos job that validates fault injectors don't leave resources running after scenarios
User acceptance: 3 support engineers run 5 scenarios and complete checklist before GA

Design (Mar 02): Add a 'compare transcript' feature to help on-call quickly surface regressions
decisions: Sandbox will reuse admin-sandbox helm chart rather than creating a new cluster to speed delivery
Failure injection will be implemented as an abstraction layer so new injectors can be added without changing templates
RBAC and SSO gating postponed to the GA milestone; alpha will use a small allowlist controlled by support leads
risks: Ephemeral worker leaks (volumes or creds) if kill path not robust — mitigation: strict teardown tests in CI
Simulator fidelity vs speed trade-off: high-fidelity network proxies slow runs — mitigation: provide 'fast' and 'full' modes
Potential for accidental use against prod if environment selection UI is misused — mitigation: confirmation & guardrails in UI
